classification.difficultyReason: Apply the shift to locate the vertex, then determine and label the intercepts. The downward shift requires solving for two roots and placing them on the sketch.

content.prompt: Let $f(x)=x^2$. Sketch each of the following graphs, labelling the intercepts with the coordinate axes.

answer.worked: Translate $y=x^2$ up 1 unit. The new vertex $(0,1)$ is also the $y$-intercept. The parabola opens upwards from $y=1$, so it does not meet the $x$-axis.

spec.sourceRegion: Exercise 9B Q2(a), top-left answer graph, printed page 370
spec.description: Upward blue parabola meeting the vertical axis at its vertex. The axes have positive-direction arrows and the parabola has a continuation arrow on each branch.
spec.mathematics: y=x^2+1; vertex and y-intercept (0,1); no x-intercepts.

answer.worked: Translate $y=x^2$ left 1 unit. The new vertex $(-1,0)$ is the only $x$-intercept. At $x=0$, $y=(0+1)^2=1$, giving the $y$-intercept $(0,1)$.

spec.sourceRegion: Exercise 9B Q2(b), top-right answer graph, printed page 370
spec.description: Upward blue parabola touching the horizontal axis to the left of the vertical axis. Both intercept values are labelled.

answer.worked:
Translate $y=x^2$ down 4 units. The new vertex $(0,-4)$ is also the $y$-intercept. For the $x$-intercepts, set $y=0$.

$$\begin{align*}x^2-4&=0\\x^2&=4\\x&=\pm2\end{align*}$$

Label $(-2,0)$ and $(2,0)$ on the horizontal axis.

spec.sourceRegion: Exercise 9B Q2(c), bottom-left answer graph, printed page 370
spec.description: Upward blue parabola with the vertex on the vertical axis below the horizontal axis and both horizontal crossings labelled.
spec.mathematics: y=x^2-4; vertex and y-intercept (0,-4); x-intercepts (-2,0) and (2,0).

answer.worked: Translate $y=x^2$ right 2 units. The new vertex $(2,0)$ is the only $x$-intercept. At $x=0$, $y=(0-2)^2=4$, giving the $y$-intercept $(0,4)$.

spec.sourceRegion: Exercise 9B Q2(d), bottom-right answer graph, printed page 370
spec.description: Upward blue parabola touching the horizontal axis to the right of the vertical axis. Both intercept values are labelled.
